ratios.quote: At June 30, 2026, our leverage ratio was 1.46 to 1.0, which meets the requirement of not being above 3 to 1.

parsed.notes: The same covenant disclosure appears in both the notes and MD&A. The leverage ratio type (gross or net) is not specified, so it is classified as total leverage. Margin and fee grids based on the leverage ratio are excluded.
